fileName.description: If loaded from a Markdown file, the name of the original file.

source.description: If loaded from Markdown, the original document content.

sourceHash.description: If loaded from Markdown, the hash code of the text content.

comment.description:
The text of Markdown (other than headings) not associated with any test case. Note that this may contain
multiple lines.

cases.description: The test cases defined as sections of the file, each of which is defined by a single code block.

hooks.description:
Optional hook code blocks defined in this test suite. Note that only one of each type may be used and they apply
to all #cases.

extraRequirements.description:
A suite may specify additional custom requirements. Tests will be generated for these requirements _in addition_ to the
standard set. This is done using a special line in the first paragraph that begins with `actionRequirement:` and contains
a comma-separated list of requirements.

These requirements must be defined, runtime-specific requirements. They must use only the supported languages,
locations, and executors and must be extensions of them. For example, `py-data-science-ipython` is valid because it's defined
as well as being an extension of a supported language and executor (Python and `ipython` respectively).

@see #supportedLanguages
@see #supportedLocations
